record.label: Total electron momentum between walk steps
record.statement: The circuit stores total electron momentum $P$ in a 42-qubit register between walk steps. The authors report that computing the sum half as often reduces the $T$ count per walk step by 10%.
record.boundary: The cited code gives the initialization needed to reuse the sum between walk steps. The 10% reduction reported in Appendix G.3 is a comparison with an earlier real-space circuit. The final Lean cost theorem bounds the cost of the new circuit.
